==Recurring Pokémon that have been caught==
Thirty-one recurring wild Pokémon were : twelve by , one by , one by , one by Jessie, one by , one by Acerola, two by James, three by Goh, two by Liko, four by Roy, two by Dot, and one by Amethio.

In Ash Catches a Pokémon, Ash caught a that he started to battle in the previous episode. It was eventually released as a in Bye Bye Butterfree.
After Ash released his in Viva Las Lapras, it has since reappeared twice as a wild Pokémon, once in Lapras of Luxury and again in Ride, Lapras, Ride!.
In Rage of Innocence, caught the , which was causing a rampage at the Lake of Rage in the previous episode.
In Channeling the Battle Zone!, Ash caught the that had been following him since Slaking Kong!. She had a habit of taking Ash's hat from him making him chase her around, sometimes lowering her eyelid and sticking out her tongue at him when he tried to get it back. She was eventually traded to in Throwing the Track Switch and evolved into an Ambipom in Journey to the Unown! under her care.
In Gotta Get a Gible!, Ash caught the that had been following him since the previous episode, after he helped him learn .
In Battling the Bully!, Ash caught the (which debuted as a Sandile) that had been following him since A Sandile Gusher of Change!. He evolved into a Krookodile in Ash, Iris, and Trip: Then There Were Three, during his battle against Iris's Dragonite.
After Ash released his in Facing the Needs of the Many!, it has since reappeared multiple times as a wild Pokémon.
In A Shockingly Cheeky Friendship!, Clemont caught the that had been following since the previous episode, and gave it to her to take care of.
After Ash released his in Beyond the Rainbow!, it has since reappeared multiple times as a wild Pokémon.
In First Catch in Alola, Ketchum-Style!, Jessie caught a after it helped attack Ash and in the previous episode. After its release in Thank You, Alola! The Journey Continues!, it has since reappeared multiple times as a wild Pokémon.
After James released his in Thank You, Alola! The Journey Continues!, she has since reappeared multiple times as a wild Pokémon.
In Rocking Clawmark Hill!, Ash caught the that lived with him and in Kukui's home since The Guardian's Challenge!. Although Kukui took care of it, it was never actually his Pokémon. It evolved into a in Rising from the Ruins!.
In One Journey Ends, Another Begins..., Ash caught the that often wandered around Melemele Island since Alola to New Adventure!. It evolved into a Torracat in Pushing the Fiery Envelope!. It later evolved into an Incineroar in Fiery Surprises!.
In Love at First Twirl!, Ash caught the that often wandered around Melemele Island since A Mission of Ultra Urgency!. He released it back into the wild in Securing the Future!.
In We Know Where You're Going, Eevee!, caught the that had traveled across the sea to Alola from Lillier and the Staff! to Don't Ignore the Small Stufful!. She gave him the nickname Sandy.
In Got Meltan?, Ash caught the that befriended in the previous episode. In Final Rivals!, it evolved into .
In The Battlefield of Truth and Love!, Acerola was revealed to have caught the -sized nicknamed Greedy Rapooh, which she tried to help in Why Not Give Me a Z-Ring Sometime?.
In Mind-Boggling Dynamax!, Goh caught the that had been following him since the previous episode. In Kicking It from Here Into Tomorrow!, it evolved into . Later in Sword and Shield... The Legends Awaken!, it evolved into .
In A Chilling Curse!, Ash caught the that haunts the Cerise Laboratory since Best Friend...Worst Nightmare!.
In Sobbing Sobble!, Goh caught the that had been following him since the previous episode.
In Sword and Shield... The Legends Awaken!, Goh caught the that appeared in Flash of the Titans!.
In Take My Thief! Please!, James caught the that had been following him since Sobbing Sobble!.
In The Ancient Poké Ball, Roy caught the that first appeared in The Pendant That Starts It All (Part Two). He evolved into a in Shine on, Terastallization! Liko vs. Roy!. He later evolved into an in Don't Give Up, Crocalor!.
In Fly! Wattrel!!, Roy caught the that first appeared in An Unexpected Picnic!. It evolved into a in Wattrel's High Wind Warning!.
In Quaxly, We Can Do It, Dot caught the that first appeared in The Pendant That Starts It All (Part One). He evolved into a in Dance, Quaxly! The Blue Medali Step!. He later evolved into a in HZ128.
In The Wonders of the World!, Liko caught the that first appeared in The Pendant That Starts It All (Part Two), nicknaming it Pagogo. It was eventually released in HZ136.
In The Knight in the Ruins, Liko caught the that first appeared in The Terapagos I Don't Know. It evolved into an in HZ124.
In Riding the Waves, Dot caught the that first appeared in The Terapagos I Don't Know. It evolved into a in Dot and Penny's Top-Secret Mission!.
Chronology, Roy's Lucario first appeared in Mega Evolution - Roy. It was later caught in Mega Evolution - Bonds.
In HZ125, Amethio was revealed to have caught the White Zygarde, which belonged to his grandfather, Gibeon, in From So Far Away. It was eventually released in HZ136.
In HZ129, Roy caught the Black Rayquaza, which belonged to Lucius, in The Ancient Poké Ball. It was later released in HZ136.
